plain_meaning: Time a container sits in a terminal or yard between arrival and departure.
ambiguity_note: Terminal dwell, rail dwell and customs dwell are different clocks; capture which one is meant.

plain_meaning: Fee charged by the carrier or terminal when a LOADED container stays inside the terminal beyond its free time.
ambiguity_note: Constantly confused with detention.

plain_meaning: Fee charged by the carrier when a container is kept OUTSIDE the terminal (e.g. at the consignee) beyond free time.
ambiguity_note: Constantly confused with demurrage; some bulletins use the words interchangeably.

plain_meaning: Daily rate for use of equipment (often a chassis or container) beyond free time.
ambiguity_note: Used loosely as a synonym for detention in some regions.

plain_meaning: Number of days before demurrage or detention starts.
ambiguity_note: Free time differs by carrier, port and container type.

plain_meaning: Last Free Day: final day before demurrage starts.
Estimated time of arrival.
ambiguity_note: Vessel ETA at the port is not the cargo ETA at the inland destination.

plain_meaning: Estimated time of departure.
Actual time of arrival.
Actual time of departure.
A scheduled sailing cancelled by the carrier.
ambiguity_note: Not the same as an omitted port call, where the vessel sails but skips a port.

plain_meaning: A vessel sails but skips a scheduled port; cargo may be rolled or transshipped.
ambiguity_note: Also written 'skipped call' or 'port omission'.

plain_meaning: Containers left behind because the vessel was full or the schedule changed.
ambiguity_note: 'Roll' is also used for rail and for booking rollovers.

plain_meaning: Cargo transferred from one vessel to another at an intermediate port. Abbreviated T/S.
Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit: the standard size unit for container volume.
ambiguity_note: One 40-foot container is 2 TEU.

plain_meaning: Forty-foot Equivalent Unit (1 FEU = 2 TEU).
Full Container Load: one shipper fills the container.
Less than Container Load: cargo from several shippers shares a container.
Refrigerated container.
ambiguity_note: Power-plug availability at the yard is a common hidden bottleneck.

plain_meaning: Out-of-gauge cargo that does not fit a standard container.
Wheeled frame that carries a container on the road.
ambiguity_note: Chassis shortage is a frequent cause of terminal dwell.

plain_meaning: Short-haul trucking between a port or rail ramp and a warehouse.
Truck collects a container and leaves the terminal gate.
ambiguity_note: 'Gate' can mean the truck gate or the rail gate; check the terminal type.

plain_meaning: Latest time to deliver a container to the terminal for a given vessel.
ambiguity_note: Document cut-off and container (CY) cut-off are different deadlines.

plain_meaning: Cargo is held by the customs authority pending examination or paperwork.
ambiguity_note: The bare word 'hold' may be a carrier hold, terminal hold, USDA/FDA hold or a customs hold.

plain_meaning: Hold placed by a Partner Government Agency such as FDA or USDA.
Non-intrusive X-ray or gamma-ray imaging exam of a container.
ambiguity_note: Lighter than an intensive exam, where the container is unloaded.

plain_meaning: Customs unloads and physically inspects the cargo.
ambiguity_note: Usually adds several days and extra charges.

plain_meaning: Customs inspects the cargo at the container door at a dock or station.
Importer Security Filing ('10+2') required by US CBP before loading.
Harmonized System goods classification (6 digits internationally).
ambiguity_note: The US HTS code is 10 digits; same family, different length.

plain_meaning: Bill of lading: transport contract and title document.
ambiguity_note: Master B/L (MBL) is issued by the carrier, House B/L (HBL) by the forwarder.

plain_meaning: Automated Manifest System (US advance cargo manifest filing).
ambiguity_note: Canada uses ACI and the EU uses ENS for the same job.

plain_meaning: Container Freight Station: where LCL cargo is consolidated or deconsolidated.
ambiguity_note: Do not confuse with CY.

plain_meaning: Container Yard.
General Rate Increase announced by a carrier.
Peak Season Surcharge.
Extra fee charged for calling at a congested port.
Contract clause excusing obligations after extraordinary events (storm, strike, war).
ambiguity_note: Carriers declare it per event; scope differs by contract.

plain_meaning: Free On Board: seller delivers goods on board the vessel; risk passes at loading.
ambiguity_note: US domestic 'FOB origin/destination' means something different from the Incoterms rule.

plain_meaning: Cost, Insurance and Freight to the destination port.
Ex Works: buyer collects at the seller's premises.
Free Carrier: seller hands goods to the buyer's carrier.
Delivered at Place: seller delivers to the named place, import duties unpaid.
Delivered Duty Paid: seller bears all costs and risks including import duties.
Intermodal rail terminal where containers are lifted on or off trains.
ambiguity_note: Also a loading ramp on a vessel or truck; context decides.

plain_meaning: Marine container terminal, rail terminal or airport terminal.
ambiguity_note: Always resolve to a node type before mapping to a node_id.

plain_meaning: Agreed time slot in which a vessel may use a berth.
ambiguity_note: Missing the window can push a vessel to the back of the queue.

plain_meaning: Vessels waiting outside the port for a free berth.
ambiguity_note: A leading indicator of port congestion.

plain_meaning: Several vessels arrive together because schedules slipped.
Space allocation on a vessel, or a truck appointment time.
ambiguity_note: Vessel slot and gate appointment slot are different things.

plain_meaning: Ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach treated as one gateway.
ambiguity_note: Ambiguous: maps to TWO nodes.

plain_meaning: Water body that contains both Los Angeles and Long Beach ports.
ambiguity_note: Ambiguous: maps to TWO nodes.

plain_meaning: Port of New York and New Jersey.
Los Angeles.
ambiguity_note: Also the airport code; in freight bulletins it normally means the seaport, check the surrounding words.

plain_meaning: Sea between Africa and Arabia that links to the Suez Canal.
ambiguity_note: Bulletins about 'Red Sea' disruptions affect Bab el-Mandeb and Suez transits.

plain_meaning: Diverting vessels around the Cape of Good Hope instead of using Suez.
Often used for the container gateway JNPT / Nhava Sheva.
ambiguity_note: Mumbai Port itself is a different, smaller port that is NOT in our network; resolve to JNPT only with context.

plain_meaning: Port cluster with several terminals (Yantian, Shekou, Chiwan).
ambiguity_note: Which terminal is meant changes the answer; we model Yantian.

plain_meaning: US CBP Cargo Systems Messaging Service: official trade advisories by email.
